verdict.rationale: HumanLayer explicitly supports multiple model backends (Claude Code, Codex, Bedrock instead of Anthropic API, plus a model selector across agent backends including GPT and Claude options), and its homepage states you can 'bring your own compute, development environment, and agent harness,' directly matching the bring-your-own-model/key story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of generic BYO-API-key configuration for arbitrary third-party LLMs beyond the named integrations, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this flexibility.
